biotools.summary: OASIS 2 is a user-friendly, offline suite for secure survival analysis, providing a portable version of the online tool to facilitate data security and accessibility without an internet connection. It provides functionalities for Cox proportional hazards regression, Wilcoxon-Breslow-Gehan test, and other survival analysis methods.
